RagShortTexts: Kidara needs landholders, merchants and followers to cooperate.
Holding a site still needs farmers, carriers and food suppliers.

Variants.Content: Kidara needs landholders, merchants and followers; holding a site still requires people willing to farm, carry and supply.

Kidara needs landholders, merchants and followers to cooperate. Followers retain family ties; decisions about guards and distant service affect common participation. Holding a site still needs farmers, carriers and food suppliers.

Holding a site still needs farmers, carriers and food suppliers. Coordination allocates actual supply and protection duties, not merely titles. Kidara needs landholders, merchants and followers to cooperate.

Kidara needs landholders, merchants and followers to cooperate. Households compare burdens with neighbors; unmatched protection weakens cooperation. Holding a site still needs farmers, carriers and food suppliers.

Holding a site still needs farmers, carriers and food suppliers. One promise may not bind every receiver, guard and supplier; negotiation needs actual responsibility. Kidara needs landholders, merchants and followers to cooperate.
